column1: # Title: Policy RES coefficients; outputs; and price multipliers
# Comment: policy.portfolio standard is just name of policy; variable can either be 'input-coef' to define the target or 'pMultiplier' to define price multiplier
# Comment: tech_mapping defines the technologies with the policy as an input; sec.out is the set of technologies that output the policy
# Comment: sec.out.type defines the output ratio for the sec.out technologies; 'standard' is 1; 'electricity' is based on the coefficients (losses); 'fossil.conv' is 1 divided by efficiency
# Comment: note the RES input coefficients for heat pump will be multiplied by calculated ambient heat efficiency
